parsed_json.up: Select the first 1000 activity rows for target CHEMBL1075319 (Transient receptor potential cation channel subfamily M member 8). Join assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter for standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and pchembl_value not null. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Sort by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id.
